name: Ganesh Housing Ltd
title: Ganesh Housing Ltd-$ - 526367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Land-bank monetisation drove FY26 profit (PAT INR316 crore vs FY25 strong year); no FY27 revenue/EBITDA guidance given until Q1, with Million Minds rent ~INR72-77 crore/yr from FY28 and Malabar Retreat completion targeted FY27.

triggers.label: FY27 guidance deferred to Q1
triggers.quote: We shall be doing that, Prit, in this results -- Q1 results when we announce that

triggers.label: Launches repeatedly delayed
triggers.quote: because of certain things, I agree with you that we have delayed certain launches

triggers.label: Phase 1 rent ~INR72-77 crore/yr
triggers.quote: we'll be probably exceeding INR 75 crores of rental income

triggers.label: Million Minds leasing 60-65% LOIs
triggers.quote: Almost 60%, 65% of the leasable area of Million Minds Phase 1 has already been laid out or in the last stages of being finalized

triggers.label: Dividend cut to 15%
triggers.quote: the Board discussed and then came at the 15% because good opportunities are coming up where the cash can be utilized for the growth

guidance.value: to be given in Q1 FY27
guidance.quote: We shall be doing that, Prit, in this results -- Q1 results when we announce that

guidance.value: completion and handover by FY27 end
guidance.quote: by FY 27 end, we should be able to complete the entire -- not only booking of that, but also handing over

red_flags.quote: Every single quarter, I think we get told that the next quarter, we will be able to give a guidance.

red_flags.quote: the last 4 quarters have been comprising of that
